info.name: Get historical data of floor price for collection for charting purposes

params.name: size
params.description: Number of data points to return

params.name: endTime
params.description: Optionally, the date-time of the last point of the graph. Defaults to current time.

items.docs: Returns list of historical floor prices aggregated at even intervals in the specified time period - last day, last month etc.  Each points represents the aggregated value of the interval after it.  The last point represents the current floor price.

info.name: Get historical data of collection volume (total sales worth) for charting purposes

params.name: size
params.description: Number of data points to return

params.name: endTime
params.description: Optionally, the date-time of the last point of the graph. Defaults to current time.

items.docs: Given a time period and the desired number of points, returns points which represent total worth of collection sales in the interval after that point.  The last point always has no value.
